origin.description: Household income and metadata from the Ilocos region, from the 1997 Family Income and Expenditure Survey and the 1998 Annual Poverty Indicators Survey.
origin.details: A data frame with 632 households and eight columns: income, sex, family.size, urbanity, province, AP.income, AP.family.size, and AP.weight. The APIS figures cover six months and were rescaled with quarterly GDP. The source is the Philippines National Statistics Office.

translation.description: Household income and metadata from the Ilocos region, from the 1997 Family Income and Expenditure Survey and the 1998 Annual Poverty Indicators Survey.
translation.details: A dict of eight columns, 632 values each. Numeric columns are income, family.size, AP.income, AP.family.size, and AP.weight. sex, urbanity, and province are text. The values are the ineq Ilocos frame.
translation.value: A dict keyed by the R column names.
